focus: This cycle shipped instead of analysed. Measured live at 2026-10-24 23:44 local: (1) E1 from the previous cycle was still NOT shipped - npx skills add hypetopher/aicompany --list printed 'No skills found / No valid skills found. Skills require a SKILL.md with name and description.', no root SKILL.md existed, gh repo view returned description:"", licenseInfo:null, pushedAt 2026-02-09, and git status showed 'main...origin/main [ahead 2]' with 11 modified files and 3319 untracked scratch files. (2) E2 was still NOT done - zero PRs ever opened by us. (3) E3 was still NOT done - no publish_skill step kind existed in EXECUTABLE_STEP_KINDS (src/services/proposal-service.ts), so the pipeline structurally could not ship anything: 22 consecutive Scout cycles had produced 100% analysis. Root cause confirmed in code: createProposalAndMaybeAutoApprove only promoted a proposal to a mission when the kinds were in the auto_approve policy, and there was no approve command at all, so any proposal needing a human sat in 'pending' forever - a proposal could never become a ship. The risk was not a missed opportunity but a structural dead end: our own pipeline was the growth blocker. This cycle therefore executed the three experiments end to end rather than proposing a fourth analysis.

risks.risk: GitHub Actions on hypetopher/aicompany has produced 0 jobs and a failure conclusion on every run since 2026-02-09 (35 runs, 12 of them on this cycle alone). Not caused by this cycle's code - the February runs fail identically with 0 jobs, which points at account-level Actions/billing rather than the workflow file. Consequence: CI is not a safety net here; the local typecheck + 26 unit tests + web build are the only real gates, and they all pass.
risks.next: Check the Actions billing/plan for the hypetopher account, or move CI to a runner we can see. Until then, do not treat a green local test run as equivalent to a green pipeline.

risks.risk: publish_skill can open pull requests on a real repository, so its blast radius is larger than any other step kind. Mitigation in place: publish_gate allowlist (hypetopher/aicompany only), never auto-approved, branch+PR only, no force-push to a default branch.
risks.next: Keep the allowlist small and review every publish proposal at approval time. Add the allowlist repo only when a proposal needs it, not upfront.

risks.risk: 3319 untracked scratch files sit in the repo working tree (_arb_*.cjs, scout-intel-*.json and similar). They are noise that makes every status check expensive and makes real changes easy to miss.
risks.next: One cleanup commit adding a scratch pattern to .gitignore, keeping the intel JSONs since they are the cycle record.

risks.risk: User-facing surfaces are still zero: ops_social_posts lifetime 0, gh gist list 0, repo 0 stars / 0 forks / 0 watchers, GitHub traffic 0. Shipping a skill is distribution, not demand - discovery is the next unsolved problem, not production.
risks.next: Measure installs of ai-company-loop and growth-intel as the next cycle's counter-metric. If installs stay at 0 after a week, the upstream marketplace entry is the thing to fix, not the skill.

experiments.hypothesis: A skill that is published through the pipeline and listed in a marketplace with real users gets installs; a skill that is only described does not.
experiments.measure: Install count of ai-company-loop and growth-intel from npx skills add hypetopher/aicompany over 7 days, and the upstream PR #546 merge status.
experiments.scope: read-only measurement plus at most one follow-up PR to fix the upstream listing if the entry turns out to be malformed
experiments.kill_criterion: 0 installs and no upstream merge after 7 days - then the channel is dead and the next experiment moves to a different surface instead of a second skill.

do_not_do: Do not write another analysis proposal that ships nothing. 22 cycles of that produced 0 artifacts; this cycle produced 2 in one run.
Do not add repos to the publish_gate allowlist ahead of need.
Do not count proposals, insights or queued steps as progress. Count merged PRs and installs.
